# OversizedContentException

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Raised when content that cannot split across pages is taller than a page and the document's `OversizedContent` is `Throw`. With the default, `Clip`, the content is drawn at the top of a page, cut off at the bottom of the body, and an error diagnostic is recorded instead.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `BonniePdfException`.
